Northern Lights Dairy Ingredients is a wholly owned subsidiary of a parent company domiciled in Ireland and operates manufacturing sites in several jurisdictions, including a spray drying facility in Poland. Consignments to North America are consolidated and transhipped through Rotterdam in the Netherlands.

Because the items above are produced at more than one site and are allocated to consignments at the point of despatch, the country of origin is not fixed at the item level and is not stated in this letter. The country of origin applicable to any given lot is declared on the shipping documents accompanying that lot — the packing list and the manufacturer's certificate of analysis — and that declaration governs. Customers requiring origin to be fixed in advance of despatch should raise it in the purchase agreement.

All sites operate to the same group specification, which is written against a reference method maintained by a standards body in Denmark. Group membership, specification and method are common to every site and are not indicators of origin.
